# vendor — offline copies of third-party libraries (don't edit)

| File | Library | License |
|---|---|---|
| globe.gl.min.js | globe.gl 2.46 (includes three.js) | MIT |
| chart.umd.min.js | Chart.js 4 | MIT |
| topojson-client.min.js | topojson-client 3 | ISC |
| d3-array.min.js, d3-geo.min.js | d3 | ISC |

`assets/textures/*` come from the three-globe examples (MIT; Earth imagery from NASA Blue Marble).
`assets/countries-110m.json` is from world-atlas (Natural Earth, public domain).
| gsap.min.js | GSAP 3 (entrance animations) | GSAP standard license (free to use; check https://gsap.com/standard-license) |

`assets/fonts/*` are Space Grotesk and JetBrains Mono (both SIL Open Font License), from Fontsource.
